<STRUCT_0001>
Papers discussing cohomology of sheaves on algebraic stacks.
<STRUCT_0002>
<STRUCT_0003> Olsson: <EMPHOPEN_0001>Sheaves on Artin stacks<EMPHCLOSE_0001> <REF_0001>
<STRUCT_0004>
This paper develops the theory of quasi-coherent and constructible sheaves
proving basic cohomological properties. This paper corrects a mistake in
<REF_0002> in the functoriality of the lisse-<ACCENT_0001>tale site. The cotangent
complex is constructed. In addition, the following theorems are proved:
Grothendieck's Fundamental Theorem for proper morphisms, Grothendieck's
Existence Theorem, Zariski's Connectedness Theorem and finiteness theorem
for proper pushforwards of coherent and constructible sheaves.
<STRUCT_0005>
<STRUCT_0006> Behrend: <EMPHOPEN_0002>Derived <MATH_0001>-adic categories for algebraic stacks<EMPHCLOSE_0002>
<REF_0003>
<STRUCT_0007>
Proves the Lefschetz trace formula for algebraic stacks.
<STRUCT_0008>
<STRUCT_0009> Behrend: <EMPHOPEN_0003>Cohomology of stacks<EMPHCLOSE_0003> <REF_0004>
<STRUCT_0010>
Defines the de Rham cohomology for differentiable stacks and singular
cohomology for topological stacks.
<STRUCT_0011>
<STRUCT_0012> Faltings:
<EMPHOPEN_0004>Finiteness of coherent cohomology for proper fppf stacks<EMPHCLOSE_0004>
<REF_0005>
<STRUCT_0013>
Proves coherence for direct images of coherent sheaves for proper morphisms.
<STRUCT_0014>
<STRUCT_0015> Abramovich, Corti, Vistoli:
<EMPHOPEN_0005>Twisted bundles and admissible covers<EMPHCLOSE_0005> <REF_0006>
<STRUCT_0016>
The appendix contains the proper base change theorem for <ACCENT_0002>tale cohomology
for tame Deligne-Mumford stacks.
